content: Fu dengee yaɓko ɗah, kina woo na ɗe woo ndengiɗ, waaye woya na ɗe woo moɗoɗ po haa a yi baab ɗu. Fu dengee fiir ci po haa ɓa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa.
Fu amb ɓitif ci findi yaay ciŋ ɗa, na cafaƴ ci findi taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa ɓitiɓ, wa hun na hool keeh-keeh.
Ɓitiɓ ci ƴaar ciŋ ɓa kaan
Ɓitiɓ ci ƴaar ciŋ ɓa kaan te ɓa raakɗi ɓi ɓaatɗohan ɓa, taambkohaa ɓa, fu eɗ ɓa cir.
Waaye ɓa raak ɓi kuɓu wala set ɗah, ɓeem ɓeɗ joy ɓa taambkoh, ɓa inah ne ɓa joy koc pes kosiŋ ɓa ŋ kahan ɓa. Ɓa tum ineem ɗah, ɓa hey wirnde ɓi rim ɓa ini ɓeem tumiɗ ɓa. Ineem weɗ ini neɓ Kooh.
Ɓitɓi maa woye ndii, a ɓitɓi ƴaar ce kaan, yi nik kiik ce. A raakɗi yi ɓaatɗohan ɗe, a oolkoh Kooh dong te a kiimee ɗe noh na wek ne Kooh ɓaatɗoh ɗe.
Waaye yi na taambɗe ini neɓ kiñin kiŋ ɗe dong, ali nik ne a ris pes sah, a kaaniɗ.
In ceem ceɗ fu joy nakoh ne ɓa woysuu ali in moɗaaɗi.
Ɓo' taambkohɗi ɓaah ciŋ ɗe, ŋ woyisɗi ɗa ɓi kahan ce ɗah, a faɗiɗ kosiŋ ɗe te a yi uup baahaaɗi kosaaɗi.
Ɓitɓi ƴaar ce kaan te a joyya fiisu ne Janguuni amboh ɗe, ƴissuut po ƴissuut, a joyiɗ raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino (60) te a joy nik ɓitɓi topee ŋ ƴaar ce.
A joyiɗ inhu ŋ in ci baahiɗ ci a tum, findi : Koɗ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe baahiɗ, na daliɗ baahiɗ ɓi na haye kahan ce, na ruhsiɗ haf ce ŋ fiki ɓo'-Kooh ci ne a ɓaatɗoh ɓa
, na ɓaatɗoh ɓi nik ŋ miskiɗ, na gen tum in baahiɗ nu wa min nikoh ɗah.
Waaye kina fiis ɓi raakɗi kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino (60), laam hel ciŋ ɓa nik ŋ raakis ƴaar ɗah, wa na ɓekee ɓa ŋ faɗ taambkoh in ciŋ Kiristaani.
Ŋ ineem, ɓooɓi raak woyɗaah ɓa ŋ ini ɓa taambiɗɗi gapohi ɓa gapee Kiristaani.
Ɓaatta nga, ini ɓa haɓɗisɗi ali in hey tahe po ɓa genan wiltiɗoh ŋ kahan ci. Ɓa topanɗi ŋ haɓɗisaaɗi ali in, waaye ɓa hey laaye nguɓ, ɓa aasee ŋ in ci waas ɓa nikohɗi, ɓa woyee mbalay.
Ineem weɗ tah po ŋ waaɗ ne ɓi ƴaar ciŋ ɓa kaan te ɓa rissa komaaki, ɓa raakis ƴaar, ɓa raak ɓi kuɓu, ɓa taambkoh kahan ciŋ ɓa baahiɗ po sangiɗi raakuu woyaah.
Raakiɗ ɓi muuƴ nga ɓa po ƴutiɗ, ɓa ɗii taambiɗ Seytaani.
Ɓitiɓ kosiɗ raak ɓaah ɓitiɓ, ɓi ƴaar ciŋ ɓa kaan ɗah, a joyiɗ ɓa ɓaatɗoh. Ineem hey eɗfiɗe pangkiŋ Janguuni po wa min taambkoh baahiɗ ɓi raakɗi ɓi ɓaatɗohan ɓa.
Yakak ciŋ Janguuni
Yakak ci na tiindɗe Janguuni baahiɗ yeyyoo'iɗ eɗu cir kanak : Ɓa joyiɗ yakɗu, ɓa joyiɗ wirndu, te ɓi ndengɗuk ŋ paysohiŋ Woo ki na jangɗohiŋ wa, ɓeɗ uup yeyyoo cireem.
Laam Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne : « Kina hondoh ñam inoh fi na dake ŋ mbong ci
ne a yon ca ! » Ɓaatta nga an : « Pangkoh joyiɗ wirndu ! »
Kina teyɗuk ne ɓo' ŋ yakak ci adgoh Janguuni yambu in, hanaa wa raak seede kanak wala kaahay ɗah.
Ɓi gen bakaaɗee, woytohaa ɓa ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen, ŋ ineem ɓinooɓi neƴƴoh, tumuu findiiɓa.
Ŋ fiki Kooh, ŋ fiki Kiristaani Yeesu na ŋ fiki malaakaaciŋ Kooh, mi yii nak ɗa ne fu taambiɗ nakoh ceem te wa hunuu na talsoh : Ɓooɓi hendaat hend nga ɗa.
Kina teel deg yaah ciŋ ɗa ŋ ɓo' ne fu tufkiɗ ɗe findi njiit, fu kee ɓaaha na ɗe bakaaɗ ci a tuman. Fu ŋ haf fu, risa ŋ kihool kiŋ ɗa.
Kina topis ŋ an masuɓ ɓarang, ambsohaa wa na biiñ ƴissuut sagu miski rookiŋ ɗa yooɓ misik.
Raakiɗ ɓooɓi nga, bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa na hotke fang, bala ɓa atte'san. Waaye ɓinooɓi, kaɗ po maañ ɗah, ciŋ ɓa han hotuk.
Wa mand ɗaa na tumohaaɗ ci baahiɗ ci. Cum na hotke fang ; ci hotukɗi ŋ saasi sah, ca minɗi ris ɗasɗukiɗ.

footnotes.text: "ruhsiɗ haf ce ŋ fiki ɓo'-Kooh ci ne a ɓaatɗoh ɓa" : Ŋ Fiis ci ndii, gerek woo ne : "naawsiɗ ɓo'-Kooh ci kot ciŋ ɓa". Marka teerndiŋ Saaŋ 13:4-17.
inoh fi na dake ŋ mbong ci ne a yon ca : ŋ jamanoonaam, ɓa meeɗeen ɓay ɓi inoh, ɓa wilɗee ca ŋ ɗafuk mbong ci, ca dakee ca po ca yon ca. Marka Rohƴiɗi 25:4
